text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I lost against Taiki, but I showed off<n>my
possibilities! I passed my test!<n>I'm going abroad
next year!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What?! Taiki's going abroad too?!<n>And she wants
to race against me<n>overseas?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, that backfired! Next up is the
Takamatsunomiya Kinen! After a race<n>on my best
distance, I'm off to take<n>on the world!
